content: Firestore realtime listeners: onSnapshot initial snapshot bills reads per returned doc; listeners re-fetch on reconnect ONLY if offline persistence is disabled (official pricing docs: 'If offline persistence is disabled, you will be charged... as if you had issued a brand-new query whenever the listener disconnects and reconnects' — persistence-enabled apps avoid reconnect re-reads). Queries with <=1 range field are not charged index-entry reads (this app's date/type queries qualify). Community pitfalls (MEDIUM): forgetting unsubscribe() leaks listeners (React Context providers that recreate subscriptions per render, Fast Refresh doubling in dev, StrictMode double-mount in dev); per-item document listeners (N+1) explode read counts and connection slots; large unbounded snapshots re-render whole lists; RN backgrounding pauses the JS engine — listeners resume on foreground with a sync burst.
